name: Water dropper in the form of a Quadruped
summary: Small vessel in the form of a winged quadruped, with head bowed and erbei wine cup attached to its forehead; with short tubular opening on the creature’s back and small circular opening on the forehead to dispense water into the cup; red earthenware with lead-fluxed, caramel-brown glaze over molded, incised, and applique decoration.
